title: B2B Telemarketer
description:

- Reach senior decision-makers within medium and large organisations.

- Ask questions to understand their challenges, priorities, and current approach.

- Identify and qualify potential opportunities.
- Book initial meetings with the Business Development Manager.
- Identify patterns in the market and suggest changes to the approach.
- Maintain accurate records in the Allo online VoIP calling system.
- Achieve agreed calling, meeting and lead-generation targets.

- Exceptional telephone and communication skills.
- Significant B2 B cold-calling experience and a proven track record of generating qualified opportunities.
- Experience speaking with senior decision-makers.
- The confidence to approach businesses that have had no previous contact with Immersionn.
- The ability to explain a complex proposition in straightforward commercial language.
- A curious, consultative approach, with strong listening and questioning skills.
- Persistence, resilience and a clear understanding of what makes a genuinely qualified opportunity.

- Initiative, resourcefulness and an interest in learning about emerging technologies.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Sales Representative - No Sales Experience Needed!

Salary: 39,600 per annum + 20% commission
Location: Field-based / UK
Hours: Full-time
Contract: Initially 12 weeks temporary, with the opportunity to become permanent
Driving: Full UK driving licence, maximum 3 points. You must be aged 25 or over for vehicle insurance purposes.

A van full of stock. A day full of conversations. A chance to earn more.

Are you the kind of person who can strike up a conversation with anyone?

We're looking for friendly, confident people to get out on the road, meet independent retailers and turn introductions into sales.

Never worked in sales before? That's absolutely fine. You'll need enthusiasm, confidence and the willingness to give it a go.

You'll be joining an established business that is the sole UK distributor of its product, giving you something different to introduce to customers.

What does a typical day look like?

You'll drive a van stocked with products, visiting 15-20 convenience stores and independent shops each day.

Walk in, introduce yourself, get to know the owner and show them what's available. When they're ready to buy, the stock is right outside, ready to sell and supply there and then.

You'll be:
- Meeting shop owners and building your own customer base.
- Introducing products and securing sales face-to-face.
- Spotting opportunities to sell more and encourage repeat orders.
- Taking payments and recording sales using company procedures.
- Keeping your van stock organised and checking stock levels.
- Planning your route and making every visit count.
- Working towards sales targets and earning commission.

Some visits will end in a sale. Some won't. You'll need to keep smiling, stay motivated and be ready for the next conversation.

Sound like you?

You don't need a sales CV packed with experience. We're looking for someone who:
- Enjoys meeting people and starting conversations.
- Has plenty of personality and a positive attitude.
- Is motivated by targets and the opportunity to earn commission.
- Can work independently and organise their day.
- Is reliable, professional and comfortable handling stock.
- Can take a "no thanks" without letting it spoil their day.

Whether you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, delivery, or you're ready for a completely new direction, we'd love to hear from you.

You must be aged 25 or over for vehicle insurance purposes and hold a full UK driving licence with no more than 3 points.

Try the role, find your feet, build your future

You'll start on a 12-week temporary assignment, giving you time to experience the role and decide whether it's for you.

If you enjoy it and the company is happy with your performance, there's the opportunity to move into a permanent position after 12 weeks.

What's in it for you?
- 39,600 annual salary + 20% commission.
- An opportunity to get into sales without previous experience.
- Variety, independence and plenty of face-to-face interaction.
- The chance to build lasting customer relationships.
- A potential permanent career with a growing business.

Got the confidence to walk into a shop, start a conversation and give it your best shot? Apply now, we'd love to meet you.
